desc:
You’ve been captured by pirates and locked away in a dark cell.
A faint light seeps in through a small opening, and the distant sound of crashing waves is all you can hear.
To escape, you'll need both courage and cleverness. Explore your surroundings, search for items, and solve puzzles.
Finding a way out of this place depends entirely on your creativity and problem-solving skills.

Will you be able to regain your freedom?

INSSA ADVENTURE EPISODE 1: PIRATE SHIP ESCAPE
